Reasonably priced, easy to assemble, stabil platform.

I have a projector from a popular EU brand, and I was looking for a stand that would fit it perfectly, without needing any extra adapters. This model is universal! It fits all major projector brands sold in the EU, including mine, so I didn't need to buy anything extra. The build quality is excellent, the steel frame is thick and solid, so it's very stable, even with larger projectors. The height adjustment is smooth and precise, I can set it exactly to the position I need for the best projection. The two shelves are very practical, the top one for the projector, the bottom one for my laptop or any other devices I need for presentations or movie nights. The wheels are easy to move, and the brakes hold the stand firmly in place. It's compliant with all EU regulations, so I can use it anywhere in the EU without any issues. I've been using it for 3 months now, and it's still in perfect condition. Highly recommended for anyone in the EU looking for a universal, reliable projector stand!

As someone who travels a lot between EU countries for work, I needed a projector stand that I could take with me and use anywhere in the EU. This model is perfect! It's fully compliant with all EU safety standards, the materials are high-quality and non-toxic, so I can use it anywhere without any concerns. The assembly is super easy, no complicated tools needed, and the instructions are available in all major EU languages, so anyone in the EU can understand them. It's very versatile, the height adjustment works perfectly for any seating position and screen size, and the two shelves are great for holding the projector, laptop or any accessories. The wheels are practical for moving it around, and the brakes hold it firmly in place. It's very stable, even with heavier projectors, and the build quality is excellent. I've used it in 5 different EU countries now, and it's been perfect every time. Highly recommended for anyone who needs a reliable, EU-compliant projector stand!
